hair.accessory.rainbow_clips_allover.description: Multiple colorful clips placed throughout hair
hair.accessory.rainbow_clips_allover.contents: 6-10 small colorful clips throughout bob. Placed at sides, crown, around face. Bright pastels - pink, lavender, mint, yellow, peach. Each clip.

hair.accessory.character_clips_collectio.contents: 8-12 decorative motif clips (3-5cm) placed throughout adult bob. Clips feature shapes like hearts, stars, flowers, butterflies, bows - fashion.

hair.accessory.pom_pom_elastics.description: Multiple small sections with pom-pom elastics
hair.accessory.pom_pom_elastics.contents: Multiple tiny sections (8-12 sections) pulled through colored elastic bands with fluffy pom-pom (2-3cm) . Pom-poms in bright pastels..

hair.accessory.scrunchies_multiple.description: Multiple colorful scrunchies on small sections
hair.accessory.scrunchies_multiple.contents: Multiple scrunchies in pastel colors (pink, lavender, blue). Gathered at multiple ponytail sections.

hair.accessory.bow_clips_everywhere.contents: 12-18 decorative bow accents (3-5cm) placed throughout adult bob hairstyle. Fashion styling accessories in coordinating pastels - some matching.

hair.accessory.flower_clips_garden.description: Garden of small flower clips throughout hair
hair.accessory.flower_clips_garden.contents: Plastic flowers (1.5-2cm) clipped throughout bob - 8-12 flowers total. Flowers in brights and pale pastels. Plastic flowers on clips. Evenly placed.

hair.accessory.butterfly_clips_flutter.contents: Plastic butterflies (2-3cm) on spring clips throughout bob - 6-10 butterflies. Colorful plastic butterflies on spring clips.

hair.rendering_digital.contents: Hair rendered digitally with strand structure and form-accurate anisotropic highlights. Dimensional depth, not flat anime hair shapes.

hair.accessory.bow_headband_oversized.contents: Wide headband (4-5cm width) in cool pastel color with enormous bow at at crown. Bow dimensions 12-15cm dramatic accent dominating bob silhouette.

hair.accessory.multiple_bow_clips.contents: 4-6 bow clips (6-8cm each) placed throughout bob. Bows in attire accent color.

hair.accessory.ribbon_woven.contents: Satin ribbon woven through hair sections. Color coordinated with dress. texture and dimension.

hair.accessory.flower_crown_bob.description: Crown of colorful flowers circling head
hair.accessory.flower_crown_bob.contents: 8-10 small or silk flowers (3-4cm each) at around crown circling head.

hair.accessory.glitter_clips_allover.contents: 8-10 small glitter clips (2-3cm) throughout bob and bangs. Clips in silver, clear, or pale colors catching light.

hair.accessory.large_side_bow.description: Single huge cheerful bow on side
hair.accessory.large_side_bow.contents: Single oversized bow (12-15cm) clipped prominently to one side of bob. Bow in stiff ribbon or maintaining shape.

hair.accessory.twin_bows_matching.description: Matching large bows on both sides
hair.accessory.twin_bows_matching.contents: Two large matching bows (8-12cm) at symmetrically at temples. Bows in bright coordinating pastels with stiff ribbon maintaining shape. Perfect mirror.

hair.accessory.barrette_parade.description: Row of colorful barrettes lined up
hair.accessory.barrette_parade.contents: 6-8 decorative barrettes (3-4cm each) lined up along one side of bob.

hair.accessory.headband_bow_attached.contents: Fabric headband (2-3cm width) with pre- bow at top center. Bow 5-8cm at at crown.

hair.accessory.alice_band_rosette.description: Alice band with big fabric rosette
hair.accessory.alice_band_rosette.contents: Plastic alice band with large rosette (6-10cm diameter) at top. Rosette rolled poofy flower.

hair.accessory.double_headband.contents: Two narrow headbands (1-2cm each) worn stacked parallel. Headbands in coordinating pastels - matching or contrasting colors. Both bands sit behind.

hair.accessory.pearl_strand_band.contents: Strand of small pearls (4-5mm) worn as headband circling crown. Pearls strung on elastic or wire. delicate band. White or cream pearls. Sits behind.

hair.accessory.flower_cluster_side.description: Cluster of flowers on one side
hair.accessory.flower_cluster_side.contents: 3-5 small flowers (2-3cm each) clustered at one temple or above ear. Flowers in white or pale pastels pinned together in grouping. floral accent on.

hair.accessory.ribbon_bow_trailing.contents: Wide satin ribbon (3-4cm) tied in bow with long trailing tails down back.

hair.accessory.bobby_pins_decorative.contents: Decorative bobby pins placed throughout. Pearl or rhinestone accents on pin heads. Multiple placements.

hair.accessory.bow_clips_temple_pair.contents: Two matching bow clips (4-5cm each) at symmetrically at temples. Bows in coordinating pastel.

hair.accessory.headband_scalloped.contents: Fabric headband (2-3cm width) with scalloped decorative edge on outer side. 6-8 gentle scallops border. Headband in solid pastel. Scallops add.

hair.accessory.clips_plus_headband.contents: Simple headband (2cm width) worn with 2-3 small bow clips (3-4cm) at sides. Headband and clips in coordinating pastels.

hair.primary.butterfly_crystal_swarm.description: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT: EXCESSIVE butterfly crystal swarm - close-up framing
hair.primary.butterfly_crystal_swarm.contents: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT at crown/top of head. Butterfly swarm: 20-30 silver chains with faceted crystals (5-18mm) plus 12-18 dimensional fabric butterflies (15-28-33cm each) in pale pink, lavender, mint, peach, cream. Chains drape around entire head. Butterflies clustered at crown and trailing along chains. Construction extends beyond frame top - only lower/middle portions visible.

hair.primary.theatrical_bow_palace.description: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT: EXCESSIVE theatrical bow palace - close-up framing
hair.primary.theatrical_bow_palace.contents: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT at crown/top of head. Bow construction (45-60-65cm) with 20-25 satin ribbon loops in blush pink, peach, cream, pale yellow. Multiple nested bow sizes. Largest loops 22-35-40cm width. Structured wiring maintaining volume. Construction extends beyond frame top - only lower/middle portions visible.

hair.primary.pearl_circlet_princess_exce.description: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT: EXCESSIVE pearl princess circlet - close-up framing
hair.primary.pearl_circlet_princess_exce.contents: PRIMARY HAIR EMBELLISHMENT at crown/top of head. Pearl circlet headband (14-26-31cm width) with 30-40 trailing pearl chains. Dense graduated pearls (4-14mm) in white, cream, blush covering wide band around head. Pearl chains cascade from band draping around temples, forehead, sides. 8-12 chains visible in upper frame catching light. Construction extends beyond frame top - only lower/middle portions visible.
